finding: QA TQ-1 (B491): malformed ledgers escaped as an uncaught ValueError (exit 1)
cause: parse_ledger handed a profile field without `=` to the unchanged verify_profile (whose dict() raised ValueError), and int()-converted unbounded digit runs (Python 3.11 refuses > 4,300 digits); compare_ledgers caught only LedgerError/OSError
fix: parse_ledger refuses, by name, a MR0C-PROFILE field that is not `name=value` before verify_profile reads it (verify_profile itself unchanged: duplicates/extras stay its contract)
parse_ledger reads the identity's lines= and each LINE's len= through count(), which refuses more than 9 digits by name before int()
no exception handling was broadened: compare_ledgers still catches only LedgerError and OSError; the run path still only LedgerError
regressions_red_first: the three new cases were run before the fix: 6 CLI failures (exit 1, traceback) + 3 shared-validator errors (ValueError); after: all pass

new_cases: test_malformed_numbers_and_profile_fields_are_named_refusals_in_either_position (stock CLI, A and B positions; valid pairs stay 0/1)
test_malformed_ledgers_are_named_refusals_of_the_shared_validator (validate_ledger raises only LedgerError, with each case's own message)
test_a_malformed_fresh_profile_line_is_a_named_refusal_of_the_run_path (a driver copy printing a bare profile token: run_profile exit 2, named)
